patterns.note: Sections are defined by generous vertical spacing and the interplay of foreground content with oversized background typography, rather than distinct containers or dividers.

Extremely large, bold, condensed sans-serif typography (Druk) is used as a primary graphic element, often serving as a background or section identifier, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast, limited palette of a warm off-white background, a vibrant electric blue for headings and accents, and black for body text creates a distinctive and bold visual identity.

As the user scrolls, large typographic elements and abstract 3D graphics positioned in the background are progressively revealed or uncovered by the scrolling foreground content, creating a dynamic sense of depth.

The hero section features the brand name in massive typography, followed by a grid of three images, which then transitions to a descriptive text block before revealing service categories through large background text.

technique_notes: To achieve the scroll-triggered motion, implement a system where large background elements (oversized text, 3D graphics) are positioned behind the main content flow. As the user scrolls, the foreground content moves at a normal rate, while the background elements either remain fixed or scroll at a slower parallax rate, causing them to be progressively revealed or obscured. This can be conceptualized as a series of layers moving at different speeds. Subtle CSS keyframe animations could be used for elements as they fully enter the viewport, enhancing their appearance.

The distinctive typographic hierarchy is built by using an extremely heavy and wide display font for hero and section titles, scaled to occupy significant screen real estate, often bleeding off-screen. This is paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other text, ensuring readability despite the dramatic scale contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, and condensed display headings (~8-10x body) dominate the page, with a clean, balanced sans-serif used for all other text elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy (especially in the hero and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness around the large typographic elements)

standout: This site's design is highly distinctive for its audacious use of typography as a primary visual and structural element. The brand name and section titles are rendered in an enormous, bold font that acts almost like a background graphic, creating a dynamic interplay with the scrolling content. This, combined with a striking two-tone color palette, makes the site feel less like a traditional marketing page and more like an interactive editorial piece.
